ring_button.label: Ring height, button
ring_button.description: Where the veil holds on the stipe on the button, as a share of the stipe from its base

ring_open.label: Ring height, open
ring_open.description: Where the ring sits on the open mushroom, as a share of the stipe from its base: real rings sit in the upper third

scales.label: Scales, open
scales.description: How wide the cuticle has torn between the scales at the margin of the open cap. The middle of the cap stays closed.

cracks.label: Cracks, old
cracks.description: How wide the cracks of the old cap are, they open late in its time. 0 = a cap that doesn't crack.
